en.title: Software Engineer
en.description: Develop end-to-end web solutions for enterprise environments using JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, Node.js (NestJS/Express), and CMS platforms such as Drupal and WordPress. Design and operate solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), build integrations with DocuSign, Firebase, SharePoint, Apigee/proxies, and Azure components, and contribute to performance, technical SEO, security hardening, CI/CD, and Docker-based delivery.

en.title: Frontend Developer
en.description: Delivered freelance web projects in Drupal and WordPress, taking interfaces from design to code, customizing themes, implementing UI with SASS, Bootstrap, and jQuery, completing pending development in an unfinished Drupal build, adding a functional shopping cart, and optimizing plugins, SEO, and server updates for smoother production launches.
